Job Summary

Role Overview: Seeking a strong Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in Python backend development, TypeScript, Angular or React, and AWS cloud services. The role involves designing, developing, integrating, testing, and deploying scalable full-stack applications in a cloud environment.

Responsibilities
Develop scalable and maintainable backend applications using Python.
Build modern frontend applications using Angular or React and TypeScript.
Design and develop REST APIs, microservices, and backend integrations.
Deploy and manage applications using AWS cloud services.
Work with AWS services for compute, storage, databases, networking, and application deployment.
Develop reusable and responsive UI components.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services.
Write clean, efficient, secure, and well-tested code.
Perform unit, integration, and functional testing.
Troubleshoot application, API, and production issues.
Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices.
Collaborate with architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation, and cloud deployment processes.
Monitor application performance and support production deployments.
Job Type

Contract

Requirements
Strong professional experience in Python development.
Strong experience with TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with Angular or React.
Strong experience developing REST APIs and backend services.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud.
Experience with microservices architecture.
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or DynamoDB.
Good understanding of Git, CI/CD, and Agile development.
Strong understanding of software development, debugging, testing, and deployment practices.

Key Accountabilities Activities

Architecture Ownership:Design microservice boundaries, data models, and event-driven
patterns (Kafka/SQS/SNS). Define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, capacity planning, and cost controls.

Scalable Java Services:Build low-latency APIs (REST/gRPC/WebSocket) for signaling, rooms,
presence, chat, recording webhooks, webhooks for AI/ASR pipelines. Optimize hot paths (JIT/GC, connection pools, backpressure, circuit breakers, bulkheads, idempotency).

Kubernetes Cloud: Lead EKS operations: HPA/VPA, PodSecurity standards, NetworkPolicies, Ingress (ALB), autoscaling, blue/green/canary.

Own Terraform stacks: VPC, subnets/NAT, WAF/Shield, ALB/NLB, ECR, EKS, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, KMS, Secrets Manager.

AWS Security Compliance: Enforce IAM least privilege, key rotation, S3 encryption/lifecycle, audit with CloudTrail/Config/GuardDuty. Implement data retention policies for recordings/transcripts.

Observability Reliability: Establish OpenTelemetry tracing, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, alerting (SLO-based).

Lead incident response, RCAs, and resilience testing (chaos, failure injection). Performance Scale

Global routing/CDN strategies, write/read segregation, caching layers, CQRS where appropriate.

Storage strategies for recordings: S3 multi-part, lifecycle Glacier, parallelized processing via Lambda/SQS.

Drive CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), infrastructure promotion (devstagingprod), and change management




Background, Skills Qualifications

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Software Engineering (or equivalent).

5+ years backend engineering; 5+ years Java in production; 5+ years Kubernetes in production.

Expert with AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, VPC design, Security Groups/NACLs, WAF/Shield, IAM, KMS).

Advanced Terraform (module design, remote state backends, workspaces, CI plan/apply, drift detection).

Knowledge of microservice architecture, event-driven systems, and distributed systems fundamentals.

Proven scaling experience: autoscaling, load shedding, rate limiting, cache strategies, DB sharding/partitioning.

Strong with PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, messaging (Kafka/SQS/SNS).

Production-grade observability and incident management track record.

[Bonus] WebRTC server components (STUN/TURN/SFU vendors like LiveKit/Janus/mediasoup), gRPC, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), cost optimization

Job Description
We are looking for a seasoned full-stack engineer to build out and manage our entire web infrastructure. Successful candidates will have a minimum of one years recent experience with all of the skills listed below.
Our project entails implementing UI, constructing our API, connecting the two, and setting up our server infrastructure. This includes all associated areas such as database and architecture design.


Responsibilities
Design and implementation of the overall web architecture
Implementation of our user interface
Design and deployment of our database
Ensuring the entire stack is designed and built for speed and scalability
Design and construction of our REST API
Integrating our front-end UI with the constructed API
Design and implementation of continuous integration and deployment


Skills
At least one years experience with:


Writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Being up on latest practices is a must, e.g., HTML5, CSS3
A relevant back-end programming language - e.g., Python, Java, or NodeJS
Database design and management, including being up on the latest practices and associated versions

Familiarity with a relevant and globally supported framework both front-end and back-end, if necessary e.g., React, Vue, Angular
Ideally, familiarity with CSS preprocessors, bundlers, and associated languages/syntaxes/libraries e.g., Sass, Less, and webpack
Thorough understanding of user experience and possibly even product strategy
Experience implementing testing platforms and unit tests
Proficiency with Git
Appreciation for clean and well-documented code
Our backed is based on Python/Django and Flask. So having experience in them is a plus

What You ll Be Doing
This role is part of our EUDR engineering team. Your work will focus on the backend systems that ingest customer-submitted farm lists, validate and transform those inputs, and run them against our deforestation detection model and geospatial datasets.
Your responsibilities will include:
Backend feature development and maintenance. Implement improvements to our EUDR backend services, refine geospatial workflows, and strengthen data checks and error handling.
Investigative problem-solving . When something doesn t look right to our Support team, you will help trace through data, assumptions, and system behavior to understand what happened and how to fix it.
Working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. EUDR is a regulated space where guidance changes, and internal requests are sometimes incomplete. You ll help clarify what s needed and translate it into practical engineering work.
Adapting the system to regulatory updates . As the EU releases new FAQs or adjustments, you will help interpret their implications and adapt parts of the system to remain consistent and compliant.
General backend engineering . Python + PostgreSQL/PostGIS development, improving observability, contributing to CI/CD pipelines, and helping make the system more resilient over time.
Although the role is primarily development-focused, you will also be responsible for applying and maintaining Terraform-based changes in AWS for the services you work on.

Full-Stack App DeveloperEquity-Only Founding Role | HiWoxAbout HiWox

HiWox is building a personalised healthcare and wellness intelligence ecosystem across 9 wellness dimensions, combining healthcare science, data, technology, devices and expert consultation.

We are building a Healthcare Operating System that collects and structures health and lifestyle data, processes it through explainable rule-based intelligence, and generates personalised recommendations, programs, rituals and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Full-Stack App Developer to build and take ownership of HiWoxs mobile and web application ecosystem.

You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure while collaborating with healthcare, data science, product and technology teams.

This is an equity-only founding opportunity for someone who wants meaningful technical ownership in building a HealthTech platform from an early stage.

Key Responsibilities1. Mobile Web Application

Build and maintain HiWox mobile and web applications.

Develop onboarding, assessments, data collection, consultation, recommendation and progress-tracking journeys.

Build responsive, scalable and user-friendly interfaces.

Develop reusable components and maintain a consistent design system.

2. Backend APIs

Design and develop scalable backend services and APIs.

Build databases and data structures for healthcare and wellness information.

Implement authentication, authorisation and role-based access.

Build APIs connecting the application with internal intelligence systems and external services.

3. Healthcare Data Integration

Structure data across HiWoxs 9 wellness dimensions.

Integrate data from smartphones, apps, wearables, rings, sensors, healthcare devices and clinical tests.

Support longitudinal health and wellness data tracking.

Build reliable data synchronisation and validation workflows.

4. Intelligence Engine Integration

Integrate HiWoxs rule-based intelligence engine with the product.

Implement workflows for wellness scores, assessments, recommendations, rituals, reminders and personalised programs.

Present intelligence outputs in a clear and explainable manner.

Support future AI and machine-learning integrations.

5. Dashboards

Develop dashboards for users, consultants, HiWox Captains, partners and internal teams.

Implement domain-wise scores, progress tracking, compliance, insights and biometric data visualisation.

Build interfaces for consultant inputs, follow-ups and program management.

6. Third-Party Integrations

Integrate healthcare devices, wearables, APIs, payment systems, communication platforms and other third-party services.

Build robust error handling and data synchronisation.

Support future connected-health and HealthTech integrations.

7. Security Privacy

Implement appropriate security controls for healthcare and personal data.

Follow secure authentication, authorisation and data-access practices.

Build with privacy, scalability, reliability and maintainability in mind.

8. Testing Deployment

Write clean, modular and maintainable code.

Perform unit, integration and application testing.

Debug and resolve production issues.

Manage deployments, monitoring and performance optimisation.

Maintain technical documentation.

9. Product Collaboration

Work closely with the Product Owner, Healthcare Scientists, Data Scientists, UI/UX team and Wellness Consultants.

Convert healthcare and product requirements into technical solutions.

Participate in architecture and technology decisions.

Take ownership of technical execution and delivery.

10. Future Technology RD

Support AI, automation, analytics and conversational interfaces.

Explore emerging wearable, connected-health and HealthTech technologies.

Contribute to proprietary technology, architecture and potential IP development.

Ideal Candidate

Bachelors/Masters degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field.

Strong experience in full-stack application development.

Strong understanding of frontend, backend, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.

Experience with mobile app development is preferred.

Experience with React Native, React, Node.js, Python, Java/Kotlin or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience integrating third-party APIs, devices or wearables is preferred.

Understanding of application security and healthcare/data privacy is an advantage.

Strong system-design and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical decisions.

HealthTech, healthcare, wellness or other data-intensive product experience is an advantage.

Engagement

Equity-only founding position.

Part-time contribution: approximately 20-25 hours/week.

Remote/hybrid engagement.

No fixed salary at the current stage.

Fixed compensation will be introduced after funding and revenue stabilisation.

Equity will be based on expertise, contribution, responsibility, commitment and long-term ownership.

Core founding members will follow a 5-year vesting structure.

Key Outcome

Build and own the technology foundation of HiWox - from mobile and web applications to backend infrastructure, healthcare data integration, dashboards and intelligence-engine integration - enabling HiWox to operate as a scalable Healthcare Operating System.
